promise: "I will build a great, great wall on our southern border, and I will make Mexico pay for that wall."
description: Trump promised a southern-border wall paid for by Mexico. Construction was funded by the United States. CRS reports 458 miles of wall panels installed during his administration, much of it replacing existing barriers.
evidence: CRS reports 458 miles installed by the end of the administration.
FactCheck.org reports $15 billion secured from US funding sources, not Mexican payment.

review.note: 458 miles is Trump-era installed panels, not all barriers existing at term end. $15 billion was total secured from several sources, not all diverted Pentagon funds. Original quotation/UTC date still require announcement transcript.
